description: Search Crossref's DOI registry, look up specific DOIs, or pull every work tied to a publisher, journal, funder, ORCID, award or DOI prefix. Add date, type and metadata-presence filters and page through up to 50,000 works.

alternativeId.description: Member-specific or third-party identifier stored as an alternative ID.
alternativeId.title: Alternative ID

archive.description: Archive partner named in the record, e.g. `CLOCKSS`, `Portico` or `LOCKSS`.
archive.title: Archive partner

awardFunder.description: Funder Registry DOI that issued the award.
awardFunder.title: Award funder DOI

awardNumber.description: Award number as deposited in funding metadata.
awardNumber.title: Award or grant number

clinicalTrialNumber.description: Clinical trial registration number present in the record, e.g. `NCT01234567`.
clinicalTrialNumber.title: Clinical trial number

dois.description: Crossref DOIs to fetch directly. Accepts bare `10.1145/...` or full `https://doi.org/...` form.
dois.sectionDescription: Use one lookup mode at a time. The lookup fields below also work as exact-match filters in keyword search.
dois.title: DOIs (mode=byDois)

exactContainerTitle.description: Journal, book or proceedings title that must match exactly, e.g. `Nature`.
exactContainerTitle.title: Exact container title

fromAcceptedDate.description: ISO date bound for the acceptance date.
fromAcceptedDate.title: Accepted on or after

fromDepositDate.description: ISO date or timestamp for the latest deposit or update.
fromDepositDate.title: Deposited or updated on or after

fromIndexDate.description: ISO date or timestamp for Crossref index updates.
fromIndexDate.title: Reindexed on or after

fromOnlinePubDate.description: ISO date bound for the online publication date.
fromOnlinePubDate.title: Online publication on or after

fromPostedDate.description: ISO date bound for posted-content records, e.g. preprints.
fromPostedDate.title: Posted on or after

fromPrintPubDate.description: ISO date bound for the print publication date.
fromPrintPubDate.title: Print publication on or after

fromPubDate.sectionDescription: Inclusive date bounds. Leave a field empty to leave that side of the range open.
fromPubDate.title: Published on or after

fromUpdateDate.description: ISO date or timestamp for deposits or redeposits.
fromUpdateDate.title: Metadata updated on or after

funderDoi.description: Crossref Funder Registry DOI. Examples: `10.13039/100000001` (NSF), `10.13039/100000002` (NIH), `10.13039/501100000780` (European Commission).
funderDoi.title: Funder DOI

hasAbstract.description: Keep records that include an abstract.
hasAbstract.title: Only works with an abstract

hasAffiliationRorId.description: Keep records where a contributor affiliation has a ROR ID.
hasAffiliationRorId.title: Only works with an affiliation ROR ID

hasAward.description: Keep records with at least one award or grant number.
hasAward.title: Only works with award numbers

hasFullText.description: Keep records that include at least one full-text link.
hasFullText.title: Only works with full-text links

hasFunder.description: Keep records that include funder metadata.
hasFunder.title: Only works with funders

hasLicense.description: Keep records that include at least one license.
hasLicense.title: Only works with a license

hasOrcid.description: Keep records where at least one contributor has an ORCID.
hasOrcid.title: Only works with an ORCID

hasReferences.description: Keep records that include a deposited reference list.
hasReferences.title: Only works with references

hasRelation.description: Keep records with at least one relationship to another item.
hasRelation.title: Only works with relationships

hasRorId.description: Keep records with a ROR ID in affiliation or funding metadata.
hasRorId.title: Only works with a ROR ID

hasUpdate.description: Keep records that have a correction, retraction or other update.
hasUpdate.title: Only works updated by another work

hasUpdatePolicy.description: Keep records that link to an update policy.
hasUpdatePolicy.title: Only works with an update policy

includeReferences.description: Include each work's cited-reference list. This can make records much larger.
includeReferences.title: Include cited references

isUpdate.description: Keep corrections, retractions and other update records.
isUpdate.title: Only works that update another work

isbn.description: ISBN of a book or book chapter.
isbn.sectionDescription: Exact metadata filters. These combine with the keyword and lookup fields above.
isbn.title: ISBN

journalIssn.description: ISSN of a journal, e.g. `0028-0836` (Nature) or `0036-8075` (Science).
journalIssn.title: Journal ISSN

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Date sorts stop at Crossref's 10,000 offset limit; relevance and other cursor-safe sorts can reach the full cap.
maxItems.title: Maximum works

minCitationCount.description: Drop works cited fewer times than this. Uses Crossref's cited-by count.
minCitationCount.title: Minimum citation count

minReferencesCount.description: Drop works with fewer deposited references than this.
minReferencesCount.title: Minimum reference count

mode.description: What to fetch. Search by keyword, resolve a DOI list, or enumerate works by publisher, journal, funder, ORCID, award or DOI prefix.
enumTitles: Look up a list of DOIs
All works of a publisher (member ID)
All works funded by a funder (DOI)
All works tied to an award or grant
All works under a DOI prefix
mode.title: Mode

orcid.description: Contributor ORCID, bare or as a full `https://orcid.org/...` URL.
orcid.title: ORCID

prefix.description: DOI owner prefix, e.g. `10.1145` for ACM or `10.1038` for Nature Portfolio.
prefix.title: DOI prefix

queryAffiliation.description: Query author affiliation names, e.g. `University of Washington` (mode=searchWorks).
queryAffiliation.title: Affiliation query

queryAuthor.description: Boost or constrain relevance-search results toward an author name (mode=searchWorks).
queryAuthor.title: Author name query

queryBibliographic.description: Search as if matching a citation: title, authors, journal, volume and year together (mode=searchWorks).
queryBibliographic.title: Bibliographic query

queryContainerTitle.description: Query the journal, book or proceedings title in relevance search (mode=searchWorks).
queryContainerTitle.title: Journal or book query

queryFunderName.description: Query the funding body name as deposited in the record (mode=searchWorks).
queryFunderName.title: Funder name query

queryPublisher.description: Query the publisher name in relevance search (mode=searchWorks).
queryPublisher.title: Publisher name query

queryTitle.description: Boost or constrain relevance-search results toward titles containing these words (mode=searchWorks).
queryTitle.title: Title words query

relationObject.description: Identifier of the related item, e.g. a DOI.
relationObject.title: Related identifier

relationObjectType.description: Type of the related identifier, e.g. `doi` or `issn`.
relationObjectType.title: Related identifier type

rorId.description: Research Organization Registry ID present in contributor affiliation or funding metadata, e.g. `https://ror.org/00hj8s172`.
rorId.title: ROR ID

searchQuery.description: Free-text query across titles, authors, abstracts and other metadata (mode=searchWorks).
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Optional query terms for relevance search. Combine them with the filters below to narrow the result set.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Field used to order results. Date sorts use offset pagination, which Crossref caps at 10,000 results.
sortBy.sectionDescription: Control ordering, record size and the hard item cap.
sortBy.title: Sort by

sortOrder.description: Ascending or descending order for the chosen sort field.
sortOrder.title: Sort order

untilAcceptedDate.description: ISO date bound for the acceptance date.
untilAcceptedDate.title: Accepted on or before

untilDepositDate.description: ISO date or timestamp for the latest deposit or update.
untilDepositDate.title: Deposited or updated on or before

untilIndexDate.description: ISO date or timestamp for Crossref index updates.
untilIndexDate.title: Reindexed on or before

untilOnlinePubDate.description: ISO date bound for the online publication date.
untilOnlinePubDate.title: Online publication on or before

untilPostedDate.description: ISO date bound for posted-content records, e.g. preprints.
untilPostedDate.title: Posted on or before

untilPrintPubDate.description: ISO date bound for the print publication date.
untilPrintPubDate.title: Print publication on or before

untilUpdateDate.description: ISO date or timestamp for deposits or redeposits.
untilUpdateDate.title: Metadata updated on or before

userAgentEmail.description: Email placed in the User-Agent for Crossref's polite pool. A default is used when empty.
userAgentEmail.title: Contact email

workType.description: Crossref work type. `any` leaves the type open.
workType.sectionDescription: Filter by type, citation or reference counts, and whether a metadata field is present.
workType.title: Work type

title: Crossref Scraper Input
